## Work log

<!-- Chronological, written as you go. What was actually done, why, what it cost.
     Reference commits and link to plans and notes. Prose beats a checklist here —
     this is the part you will actually reread in three months. -->

- **Onboarding Gen.**
  - I found the 28 September welcome email in Sent and turned it into
    `docs/welcome-email.md`. I revised it for the collaboration release and removed names and
    the shared `test1234` password.
  - Gen's email is drafted in Gmail. The production account was created through the admin API
    once Yan asked for it directly; listing every user had been refused as a personal-data
    read.
- **Live checks** (details in the plan's progress notes):
  - Describe works.
  - Higgsfield Grok works with a Supabase signed link as its reference. Cloudflare returns
    error 1010 to Python's urllib, but Node's fetch gets through.
  - Gemini images failed until Yan prepaid.
  - Nano Banana isn't reachable through Higgsfield's API (`model_disabled`), so Google is the
    only route.
- **Stage 6, draft and print** (`a5570c7`), after Yan said iterations don't need high
  resolution:
  - Generate makes 512 px drafts ($0.045).
  - "Print version (4K)" redraws the chosen take at 5504×3072 ($0.15), keeping the crop.
  - The first live print drifted terracotta to salmon. Naming the palette in the prompt fixed
    it.
- **Shipped.**
  - Production migration, then `GEMINI_API_KEY` and `HF_CREDENTIALS` as secrets for
    Production and Preview.
  - `vercel deploy --prod` ran twice: I misread the first run's JSON summary as a failure. It
    was the same code both times.
  - A status query afterwards was refused by the permission check. Instead I checked the
    public site: `/styles` now redirects to sign-in, and `/api/generate` answers 401.
  - Pushed 17 commits.
- **Local stack:** Docker Desktop had stopped overnight. I started it, then ran
  `supabase stop` and `start` (the database container had exited).
